input.request: Build Invoice Flow, a payable-invoice page. Token name: Invoice Flow. Token symbol: INVC. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. InvoiceBook lets a payee create an invoice for a payer, amount, due time and bytes32 memo; the named payer pays before expiry, or the payee cancels an unpaid invoice. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a wallet-connected page to create, pay, cancel and inspect invoices.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Every constructor may use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Each state change is called and gas-paid by the payee or payer because it directly creates, settles or cancels that party's invoice.

draft.objective: Build and review INVC and InvoiceBook, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live invoice-settlement website.

steps.objective: Implement the fixed-supply token and InvoiceBook as a Foundry project.
Test authorization, expiry, exact transfers, and terminal invoice states.
Independently adversarially review both contracts and tests.
Build the deployed-address invoice page with clear transaction states.
